create_resnet_lipreading_model: create a ResNet model for lipreading with configurable block type, layer depths, and relu activation
build_basic_block: build a residual basic block with two convolutions, batch normalization, and configurable relu or prelu activation
configure_downsample_block: configure a downsample block using conv-based or avg-pool-based stride reduction for residual connections
build_conv3x3_layer: build a 3x3 convolutional layer with configurable input/output channels and stride, no bias
test_resnet_forward_pass: test the ResNet forward pass through four layers, adaptive average pooling, and flattening
